instructions: How to use this file: The essential elements are all 'id', 'type', 'form', 'order', and 'translation' items and the paths leading to them, as well as the root elements 'creator' (must be left as is), 'key', 'display', and 'rtl'. All other items, including this text, are non-essential and will not be regarded during an import operation. Furthermore, subsets of this file can be created and used at will, as long as it remains valid JSON. The 'hash' items are not essential, but assist in tracking if a default value has changed since the file was created, and thus a translation may be out of date. During an import operation, a best-effort approach is taken. Any paths and/or ids that do not match the target will be silently ignored. Thus, a cross-project import of field translations would only work for fields of the same name.

header.default: Severity of Posttraumatic Stress Symptoms - Adult
header.translation: Gravedad de los síntomas de estrés postraumático - Adulto

label.default: Please list the traumatic event that you experienced
label.translation: Por favor, indique el evento traumático que experimentó.

label.default: Having "flashbacks", that is, you suddenly acted or felt as if a stressful experience from the past was happening all over again (for example, you reexperienced parts of a stressful experience by seeing, hearing, smelling, or physically feeling parts of the experience)?
label.translation: Tener "flashbacks", es decir, de repente actuó o sintió como si una experiencia estresante del pasado volviera a suceder (por ejemplo, volvió a experimentar partes de una experiencia estresante al ver, oír, oler o sentir físicamente partes de la misma). experiencia)?

label.default: Feeling very emotionally upset when something reminded you of a stressful experience?
label.translation: ¿Se siente muy molesto emocionalmente cuando algo le recuerda una experiencia estresante?

label.default: Trying to avoid thoughts, feelings, or physical sensations that reminded you of a stressful experience?
label.translation: ¿Está tratando de evitar pensamientos, sentimientos o sensaciones físicas que le recordaron una experiencia estresante?

label.default: Thinking that a stressful event happened because you or someone else (who didn't directly harm you) did something wrong or didn't do everything possible to prevent it, or because of something about you?
label.translation: Culparse a sí mismo o a otra persona de la experiencia estresante o de lo que sucedió después?

label.default: Having a very negative emotional state (for example, you were experiencing lots of fear, anger, guilt, shame, or horror) after a stressful experience?
label.translation: Tener fuertes sentimientos negativos tales como miedo, terror, ira, culpa o vergüenza?

label.default: Losing interest in activities you used to enjoy before having a stressful experience?
label.translation: ¿Perder interés en actividades que solía disfrutar antes de tener una experiencia estresante?

label.default: Being "super alert", on guard, or constantly on the lookout for danger?
label.translation: ¿Estar "súper alerta", en guardia o constantemente atento al peligro?

label.default: Feeling jumpy or easily startled when you hear an unexpected noise?
label.translation: ¿Se siente nervioso o se asusta fácilmente cuando escucha un ruido inesperado?

label.default: Being extremely irritable or angry to the point where you yelled at other people, got into fights, or destroyed things?
label.translation: ¿Estar extremadamente irritable o enojado hasta el punto de gritarle a otras personas, pelearse o destruir cosas?

header.default:
People sometimes have problems after extremely stressful events or experiences. How much have you been bothered during the PAST SEVEN (7) DAYS by each of the following problems that occurred or became worse after an extremely stressful event/experience?

0=Not at all, 1=A little bit, 2=Moderately, 3=Quite a bit, 4=Extremely"
header.translation:
A veces las personas tienen problemas después de eventos o experiencias extremadamente estresantes. ¿Cuánto le ha molestado durante los ÚLTIMOS SIETE (7) DÍAS cada uno de los siguientes problemas que ocurrieron o empeoraron después de un evento/experiencia extremadamente estresante?

0=Nada, 1=Un poco, 2=Moderadamente, 3=Bastante, 4=Muchísimo
